index.lede: Hivesigner keeps your Hive keys on your own device, shows you exactly what a transaction does before you sign it, and lets apps ask for only the permission they need.
index.title: Hivesigner
index.description: Hivesigner is a secure way to sign in to Hive apps. It gives users strong protection for their keys and gives developers the industry-standard OAuth2 to integrate with.
index.preview_wants_access: Wants to access your Hive account
index.preview_with_posting: With your posting authority, {app} will be able to:
index.preview_can_post_body: Publish posts and comments on your behalf
index.preview_can_vote_body: Upvote and downvote with your account
index.preview_can_follow_body: Follow, mute and reblog on your behalf
index.preview_one_grant: All of this is one posting-authority grant, created on this device. The app never receives a key, and it cannot touch your funds.
index.preview_caption: What a permission request looks like.
index.preview_revoke: You can revoke any app at any time.
index.dev_body: Add Hive sign-in to your app with OAuth2, and let people grant posting access without ever handing over a key.
index.trust_scope_body: Login only, or posting on your behalf

authorize.request_access: {app} is requesting access to your account.
authorize.redirect_not_registered: This app's redirect URL is not registered. For your safety, sign-in is blocked.
authorize.grant_explain_no_account: {app} is asking to post, comment, vote and follow on your behalf. Add an account to continue.
authorize.grant_explain: {app} will be able to post, comment, vote and follow as {account}.
authorize.request_verify: {site} wants to confirm your Hive username.
authorize.callback_invalid: This site asked to be sent your login to an address that is not a web URL. Go back to the site and try again.
authorize.callback_insecure: This site asked to be sent your login over a plain http:// address. Hivesigner only sends it over https. Ask the site to use a secure address.
authorize.requires_active_key: This transaction requires your active key.
authorize.active_key_label: Active key or master password for {account}
authorize.active_key_hint: Checked against the account on-chain, then saved on this device with your other keys. It never leaves this browser.
authorize.app_not_found: {app} is not a Hive account, so there is no app to authorize. Go back to the site and try again.
authorize.read_failed: Could not load the account details from the Hive network.
authorize.account_missing: {account} was not found on the Hive network.
authorize.active_key_passcode_hint: This account is protected on this device. Its passcode saves the new key under the same protection.
authorize.not_active_key: That is not an active key of {account}. Paste the active key or the master password.
authorize.wrong_passcode: Wrong passcode. The key was not saved.
authorize.active_key_needed: This needs the active key of {account}.
authorize.add_key_to_continue: Add a posting or active key for {account} to continue
authorize.still_confirming: Authorization was submitted but is still confirming. Please try again in a moment.
authorize.first_time_grant: First-time authorization: this adds {app} to your posting authority on-chain and needs your active key once. That account will be able to post as you until you revoke it.
authorize.already_authorized: You authorized {app} before. Nothing new is granted.

import.add_account_hint: Unlock your Hive account on this device. Your keys are encrypted and never leave this browser.
import.invalid_username_password: Invalid username or key. Use your master password or your owner, active, posting or memo key.
import.private_key_hint: A posting key covers everyday actions such as posting and voting. Wallet actions and authorizing an app for the first time need the active key. A master password covers both. The key is stored on this device and never sent anywhere.
import.passcode_hint: A local password, separate from your Hive keys. It encrypts the key on this device and unlocks it again. It is not your Hive password and cannot be recovered.
import.passcode_needed: This account is protected on this device. Enter its passcode to add the key.
